caption: Our draft invoice adds Dutch VAT by itself: EUR 10.00 net, BTW 21% EUR 2.10, total EUR 12.10. The street address is hidden.
The saved draft shows up in the invoice list for our test client at EUR 12.10, due 23 Nov 2026, and the Drafts card counts it as not sent yet.
Adding a team member asks only for a name and an email address; there is no choice of role or access level.
The Developers tab lets you create API keys to connect your own tools; the list was empty and we did not create one.
